Five days after discontinuation, the anxiety-like behavior had subsided, but activation of serotonin-producing neurons in the dorsal raphe nucleus persisted. The paper was published in Neuropharmacology .

Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or SSRIs, are a widely used class of antidepressant medications. They are commonly prescribed to treat depression and some anxiety disorders.
